verification.note: Full output includes every inventory/valuation field, provenance, economic timestamp, sequence, revision, manifest, availability state, lot, match and cost. No recordedAt or other field is stripped from a financial DTO.

scope.tradeMeaning: Deterministic complete round-trip groups in kernel inputs; actual journal trade rows and SQL row counts are measured separately by the database benchmark.
scope.payloadMeaning: UTF-8 byte length of the complete canonical JSON array of internal kernel inventory plus valuation results, not an API response or transferred network payload.

sources.afterState: Uncommitted Phase15 working tree; no commit, push or merge.
sources.fingerprintNote: Source fingerprints recorded at evidence assembly; benchmark artifacts were collected from the pristine baseline worktree and the reviewed optimized working tree respectively.

environment.build: Standalone TypeScript kernel through tsx; separate from production Next.js and React profiling builds.

methodology.sourceRevision: Dataset execution count, with source revisions and verified economic sequences 1 through that count.

financialContext.feeCurrency: Every fifth execution EUR; other charges USD.
financialContext.quantities: Seeded exact integer ten-thousandths, formatted with BigInt; entry and exit partial fills have equal quantity within a trade.
financialContext.directions: Both long and short; every seventh trade is short.
financialContext.outcomes: Seeded prices with positive, negative and zero quote-price changes; native and reporting costs retain charged-currency rates.
financialContext.metadata: Four ordinary-share instrument/unit identities in distributed histories; one in concentrated history. All metadata/version and FX observation references are pinned in the canonical input hash.

distributions.concentrated: One account, one instrument, one book containing the complete history.
distributions.distributed: 100 accounts and four instruments, 400 books; 10 trades/account at the 1000-trade scale and 100 trades/account at the 10000-trade scale.

methodology.persistence: Pass --fixture-dir for persisted complete input JSON. Exact canonical input hashes prove equality with the earlier deterministically regenerated fixtures. The quiet pair and extended100k use shared persisted inputs; all AFTER scenarios use persisted inputs.
methodology.hashing: SHA256 of complete JSON with recursively sorted object keys; array ordering, values, economics and all provenance remain intact.
methodology.timing: operationMs sums replay and reporting valuation only. Fixture generation/read/write, canonical input hashing, output serialization/hashing and forced GC are excluded. Separate serializationAndHashMs, loopWallMs, fixturePreparationMs and memory observations are retained.
methodology.statistics: Median (middle value, or mean of middle values for even counts), arithmetic mean, minimum, maximum and nearest-rank p95. With three samples p95 is only the observed maximum, not a production tail-latency claim.
methodology.cacheAndConcurrency: Fresh Node process per matrix scenario, concurrency1 within a scenario, one complete warmup except the explicitly cold extended100k equivalence run. No OS cache flush or CPU affinity. Shared-host contention is disclosed separately.
methodology.memory: GC requested before each warmup/sample using --expose-gc. Heap/RSS sampled at book boundaries including canonical output serialization; transient peaks inside one synchronous book are not observed. Whole-process RSS high-water mark includes preparation/serialization. These samples are not proof of production request-leak behavior.

quiet20kPair.context: Coordinated quiet project CPU window; fixture construction and other project benchmarks paused. The host is still shared infrastructure.
quiet20kPair.ratioUse: This local quiet pair is the only performance-factor claim; no factor is inferred from the contended full matrix.

profile.scope: Separate original20k concentrated profiling run,0warmups/1sample; not included in benchmark sample statistics.
profile.limitation: tsx-transformed source positions map to line1; anonymous frame identified by parent processFill and inspected source. Sampling weights include scheduling effects; separate profile is not a benchmark timing run.
profile.decision: Replace per-fill scans of all retained historical lots with a local Set of nonzero WorkingLot object references. Preserve the complete historical lots/matches DTO and all Decimal calculations, cost attribution, transfer validation and ordering.

capacityObservations.deadlineScope: Whole scenario process including fixture preparation, warmup and repetitions.
capacityObservations.note: The process exceeded 120 s before any measured sample completed. The checkpoint does not establish whether it was in warmup or the first measured sample. This was not a successfully computed 100k concentrated report or a precise operation-duration measurement.

capacityObservations.classification: Equivalence-only; cold single sample contended with fixture preparation and other work. No before/after speed factor.

limitations: No SQL, restricted database role/RLS plan, API, browser, ledger write, import throughput or production frontend claim is made by this evidence.
Pure kernel trade groups are not SQL journal trade rows; actual persisted table counts are supplied by the database fixture benchmark.
All economic instants are pinned to one microsecond with verified ordering sequences; temporal/date-filter performance is not exercised.

FIFO complete round trips only; equal-sized partial fills within each group. Open positions, transfers, policy transitions, source corrections, late attribution, orders, ledger postings and database projections are omitted from throughput fixtures.
Existing and new regression tests cover transfer/late-cost/policy/correction correctness, but that does not measure those workflows at100k scale.
Full internal financial DTO sizes are deliberately large because closed lots, matches, costs and provenance remain present. They are not API/network payload measurements.
Application campaign/fact/response limits and SQL statement timeouts are neither bypassed through an API nor removed; this harness directly exercises the pure kernel.

The full matrix has different external contention and the concentrated100k BEFORE has different warmup/repetition settings. Only full financial equivalence and raw observations are claimed there; only the quiet20k pair supplies a speed factor.
Forced-GC book-boundary memory samples do not establish absence of production leaks or exact intra-book peaks.
